name: Dynamic Galaxy Updates

# 🌌 Keeps the profile alive:
#   - Live Dhaka time + Bengali date in the README
#   - Rotating developer/security quote (API with local fallback)
# Runs every ~30 minutes (offset :07/:37 to avoid clashing with other workflows).

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '7,37 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: dynamic-readme
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update-dynamic:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Update time & quote in README
        run: python .github/scripts/update_dynamic.py

      - name: Commit and push if changed
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add README.md
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "🌌 auto: refresh Dhaka time & quote [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
